background: Karin Richard of Cody ran for the Park County commission in 2024 and again in the 2026 Republican primary. The Powell Tribune reported in March 2024 that she had owned Outdoor Adventures Revived (OAR), a used outdoor-gear store, for the previous six years and that before opening the store she had worked in health, fitness, and recreation for almost 30 years. She lost the 2026 Republican primary.
